newsitem.title: USA: Strawbridge to make May distribution.
newsitem.headline: Strawbridge to make May distribution.

text.p: Strawbridge & Clothier said Monday that it intends to make a yet undetermined "substantial" partial distribution of shares of May Department Stores Co in July.
It said the dividend represents the quarterly cash dividend to be received by the company on the May shares currently held from the sale of Strawbridge assets to May.
Strawbridge earlier declared a quarterly cash dividend of $0.128 per share on Monday. The company said it declared the cash dividend so that shareholders will not be without a return until July.
The company said it is continuing to operate under its Plan of Reorganization and Liquidation approved by shareholders in July 1996.
Under the plan, the remaining assets and obligations will be transferred to a liquidating trust by July 18, 1997.
A final distribution of remaining May shares, if any, will be made at the termination of the liquidating trust, which is estimated to occur by July, 1999.
The company estimated that the total number of May shares to be received for each outstanding Strawbridge & Clothier share is about 0.37.
Strawbridge also said that it has an agreement in principle for the purchase of its Clover Store at Mercerville, which should close this week, leaving the Shore Mall as its only continuing operation.
